description: ENERGO - Ovlašteni plinoistalateri, serviseri i projektanti za plinske instalacije i dimnjačarske radove is a dataset listed in Open Data Portal Croatia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Grad Rijeka. Ovlašteni plinoistalateri, serviseri i projektanti za plinske instalacije i dimnjačarske radove. Coverage: Grad Rijeka. The portal shows the English title as "ENERGO - Authorised gas plumbers, repairers and designers for gas installations and chimney sweeps" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Grad Rijeka. Its keywords include projektanti, serviser, dimnjačarski radovi, plinske instalacije, plinoinstalateri. The listing shows 1 download or service links in PDF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-portal-otvorenih-podataka.
